tagline: Istanbul's most connected transit hub — the M2 metro and TEM highway junction, surrounded by business towers and a dense commercial district.

items.name: Mecidiyeköy AVM Kafeler
items.description: Multiple café chains in and around the shopping centres near the metro. Practical and accessible.

items.name: Trump Towers ve Çevresi Restoranları
items.description: The Trump Towers complex and surrounding streets have a range of restaurants across price points. Practical for business lunches.

items.name: Mecidiyeköy Yan Sokak Lokantalari
items.description: The side streets off the main boulevard have honest lokanta restaurants popular with office workers. Great value.

tips: Mecidiyeköy is one of Istanbul's major metro junctions (M2 line) and bus hub.
Primarily a commercial and transit district — not a leisure destination.
The side streets away from the main road have surprisingly good local food at low prices.
Şişli (one metro stop south) has more character; Levent (north) has the business towers.
